answer:
**答案(最终自然语言假设,已执行主体分析):**

> **Interviews(访谈)是 ML-enabled 系统项目中获取需求最常用的技术。** 在 Q9 的有效受访者中(n = 194,剔除 82 名因中途退出而未被展示该题的受访者),97 人(50.000%)在其项目中"quoted"了访谈,显著高于 Scenarios(75 人,38.660%)与 Prototyping(75 人,38.660%)、Workshops/Meetings(74 人,38.144%)、Observation(64 人,32.990%),行级配对自助法(B = 10,000,seed = 42)给出 Interviews 的 95% CI 为 [42.78, 57.22](BCa [42.27, 56.19]),且在 97.3% 的重抽样复制中排名第一;与并列次名的配对差值为 11.34 个百分点(95% CI [1.55, 21.13],单侧 p̂ ≈ 0.012–0.014;McNemar 精确单侧 p = 0.014–0.017),即差异在 5% 水平显著但余量有限(差值 CI 下界仅约 1–2 个百分点);"Others"仅 5.670%,作为旁证不参与评选。题述数值(69.399%,CI 半宽 0.3365pp ⇒ 等效 n≈72,000,在 n ≤ 276 的行级自助法下不可能出现)应来自参考实现所用的另一份清洗/加权数据,本文件可复现其**排序**而非其绝对水平。

**已执行 Step 1–7(脚本 `analysis/q9_elicitation_bootstrap.py`,输出见 artifacts)。**

1) 主口径比例(n=194,use := value=='quoted'):
| 技术 | n | % | 95% CI 百分位 | BCa | 正态 | 复制中居首比例 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Interviews | 97 | 50.000 | [42.78, 57.22] | [42.27, 56.19] | [42.96, 57.04] | 0.9732 |
| Scenarios | 75 | 38.660 | [31.96, 45.36] | [30.93, 44.84] | [31.81, 45.51] | 0.0104 |
| Prototyping | 75 | 38.660 | [31.96, 45.36] | [31.44, 44.84] | [31.81, 45.51] | 0.0081 |
| Workshops_Meetings | 74 | 38.144 | [31.44, 44.84] | [30.93, 44.33] | [31.31, 44.98] | 0.0020 |
| Observation | 64 | 32.990 | [26.29, 39.69] | [25.77, 39.17] | [26.37, 39.61] | 0.0004 |
| Others(仅旁证) | 11 | 5.670 | [2.58, 9.28] | [2.58, 8.76] | [2.42, 8.92] | 0.0000 |

2) 配对显著性(B=10,000;seed 42/0/12345 结果一致到 3 位小数,证不敏感性;含 mid-p 处理并列):Interviews−Scenarios 差 11.340pp(SE 5.041)CI [1.55, 21.13] p̂=0.0142(mid-p 0.0127),McNemar b=60/c=38 p=0.0167;Interviews−Prototyping 11.340pp(SE 4.885)CI [2.05, 21.13] p̂=0.0116,McNemar b=57/c=35 p=0.0140;Interviews−Workshops 11.856pp CI [3.61, 20.62] p̂=0.0035,McNemar p=0.00477;Interviews−Observation 17.010pp CI [6.70, 27.32] p̂=0.0004,McNemar p=0.00092;Interviews−最强次名(max-over-others)11.340pp CI [0.00, 16.50] p̂=0.0268(mid-p 0.0239)。**如实结论:Interviews 点估计居首且 10 个敏感性口径下排序全部一致,对每个次名单侧 p̂≈0.011–0.014(5% 显著),但对"最强次名"的 p̂≈0.027、配对差 CI 下界接近 0,显著性余量有限。**

3) 敏感性网格(分母 × 分子规则,第一名归属全表一致为 Interviews,见 `output/sensitivity_grid.csv`):D=276 且负值留于分母 → Interviews 35.145%(次名 27.174,差 7.971);D=276/D=194 负值剔除 → 50.000%;D=174(至少提及一项)→ 55.747%(差 12.644);D=164 仅 Completed → 51.829%(次名 Prototyping 39.024,差 12.805);D=188 Completed+after-break → 50.532%(差 10.638)。规则 A/B 仅在 D=276 时不同(S1/S2),恰说明"负值处理"只改变绝对水平(35.1% → 50.0%)而不改变排序。

4) 与题述数值偏差表(`output/deviation_vs_reported_value.csv`):所有 10 个口径下 Interviews 比例 35.145–55.747%,对 69.399 的偏差为 −34.25 至 −13.65pp,无一落在 [69.062, 69.735] 内;自身 CI 半宽 7.216pp vs 题述 0.3365pp。

5) 录入噪声处置(未静默删除,记录于 `output/data_integrity_log.csv`):Others 'quoted' 但无可用自由文本 n=1(含 Others_Free 唯一 1 行 NaN)→ 保留计入 Others(5.670%),不参与结论;有自由文本但未标 'quoted' 的行 n=0。

6) 可追溯性:所用列 = Q9_ML_Elicitation_Interviews / _Scenarios / _Prototyping / _Workshops_Meetings / _Observation / _Others / _Others_Free + Status(质量核查)。关系陈述:负值编码('-77'/'-66'/'-99')→ 结构性未展示 → 有效分母由 276 变为 194 → 各技术绝对比例改变 → 技术间排序不变。脚本已做一次清空 output 后的端到端重跑,结果可复现(确定性种子)。

payload.hypothesis: Interviews (访谈) is the most commonly used technique for eliciting requirements in ML-enabled system projects: 97 of the 194 respondents with a valid Q9 response (50.000%, 95% bootstrap CI [42.78, 57.22]; B=10,000 row-level resampling, seed 42, percentile method) reported using interviews, ahead of Scenarios and Prototyping (75 each, 38.660%), Workshops/Meetings (74, 38.144%) and Observation (64, 32.990%); 'Others' is descriptive only (11, 5.670%). Interviews is ranked first under every one of the 10 denominator x numerator-rule sensitivity specifications, and the paired bootstrap gap to the runners-up is 11.34 pp (95% CI [1.55, 21.13], one-sided p-hat 0.011-0.014; exact McNemar p 0.014-0.017), i.e. significant at the 5% level though with a limited margin. Methodological note: the 69.399% with 95% CI [69.062, 69.735] quoted in the question has a CI half-width of 0.3365 pp (implied effective n ~ 72,000, impossible for row-level bootstrapping of <=276 rows), so that value must come from the cleaned/weighted dataset used by the reference implementation - this file reproduces its ranking, not its absolute level.
payload.workflow: Step1 load CSV (276x202, 276 unique IDs) and locate Q9 columns (+ Q9_ML_Elicitation_Others_Free, Status); Step2 dump raw value counts and audit negative codes ('-77' on 82 identical rows across all six technique columns; equals Others_Free=='-66'; 82/88 Suspended respondents) -> treat negative codes as structurally missing; Step3 recode quoted->1, 'not quoted'->0, negatives->NaN (valid n=194), log (not drop) the 1 'Others' quoted row lacking free text incl. the single Others_Free NaN; Step4 compute proportions under primary spec (use:=quoted, negatives out of numerator and denominator) plus a 5x2 sensitivity grid (D=276/194/174/164/188 x rule A negatives-removed vs rule B negatives-in-denominator) with per-spec winner; Step5 row-level paired bootstrap B=10,000 on the 194 valid rows, seeds 42/0/12345, percentile 95% CI primary with BCa (jackknife acceleration) and normal approximations as controls, per-technique 'above all others' replicate share, paired diffs Interviews minus each other named technique and minus the best-of-others with one-sided p-hat and mid-p, complemented by exact one-sided McNemar tests on discordant pairs; Step6 deviation table vs 69.399% / [69.062, 69.735] plus CI-implied-n diagnostic (half-width 0.3365 pp -> n~72,000 vs own 7.216 pp at n=194); Step7 verdict with variables and relation traced, plus a clean-slate end-to-end re-run to confirm reproducibility.
